## Leave-One-Out VALIDATION
```{r}
## LOO VALIDATION

library(future.apply); library(progressr); library(dplyr); library(INLA)

load("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Bayesian Spatial Modeling/Data/Validation Data/LOO_validation_inputs.RData")

outdir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Bayesian Spatial Modeling/OutPut"
ckpt <- file.path(outdir,"LOO_PI_checkpoints")

### TRUE whenever data/model changes; FALSE to resume same run
data_changed <- FALSE
if(data_changed) unlink(ckpt,recursive=TRUE)
dir.create(ckpt,showWarnings=FALSE)

### SPATIAL GRAPH
gf <- file.path(outdir,"district_adjacency_LOO.graph")
spdep::nb2INLA(gf,nb)
gp <- normalizePath(gf,winslash="/",mustWork=TRUE)

### LOO JOBS
jobs <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(sp="R",i=which(!is.na(model_data$R_log))),
  data.frame(sp="H",i=which(!is.na(model_data$H_1000)))
)

files <- file.path(ckpt,paste0("job_",seq_len(nrow(jobs)),".rds"))
todo <- which(!file.exists(files))
cat("Completed:",nrow(jobs)-length(todo),"/",nrow(jobs),"| Remaining:",length(todo),"\n")

### PARALLEL SETUP
future::plan(future::sequential); gc()
future::plan(future::multisession,workers=3)
handlers(handler_progress(format="[:bar] :percent | :current/:total | elapsed :elapsed | ETA :eta"))
options(progressr.enable=TRUE)

### RUN LOO
if(length(todo)>0) with_progress({
  p <- progressor(length(todo))

  future_lapply(todo,function(j){
    INLA::inla.setOption(num.threads="1:1")
    sp <- jobs$sp[j]; i <- jobs$i[j]
    y <- if(sp=="R") "R_log" else "H_1000"

    tryCatch({
      d <- model_data; d[[y]][i] <- NA

      m <- INLA::inla(
        as.formula(paste0(y,"~PC1+PC2+PC3+PC4+livestock_z+",
                          "f(district_id,model='bym2',graph='",gp,"',scale.model=TRUE)")),
        family="gaussian",data=d,control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE)
      )

      f <- m$summary.fitted.values[i,]
      tau <- m$summary.hyperpar[
        grep("Precision for the Gaussian observations",rownames(m$summary.hyperpar))[1],
        "0.5quant"
      ]

      psd <- sqrt(f$sd^2+1/tau)
      plo <- f$mean-1.96*psd; phi <- f$mean+1.96*psd

      if(sp=="R"){
        predicted <- exp(f$`0.5quant`)*1000
        cri_low <- exp(f$`0.025quant`)*1000; cri_high <- exp(f$`0.975quant`)*1000
        pi_low <- exp(plo)*1000; pi_high <- exp(phi)*1000
        observed <- model_data$R_tick[i]
      } else {
        predicted <- f$`0.5quant`*1000
        cri_low <- f$`0.025quant`*1000; cri_high <- f$`0.975quant`*1000
        pi_low <- plo*1000; pi_high <- phi*1000
        observed <- model_data$H_tick[i]
      }

      z <- data.frame(
        Species=ifelse(sp=="R","R. microplus","H. anatolicum"),
        District=model_data$ADM2_EN[i],Observed=observed,Predicted=predicted,
        CrI_Lower95=cri_low,CrI_Upper95=cri_high,
        PI_Lower95=pi_low,PI_Upper95=pi_high
      )

      z$CrI_Covered95 <- with(z,Observed>=CrI_Lower95 & Observed<=CrI_Upper95)
      z$PI_Covered95 <- with(z,Observed>=PI_Lower95 & Observed<=PI_Upper95)

      saveRDS(z,files[j])

    },error=function(e) message("FAILED: ",model_data$ADM2_EN[i]," | ",e$message))

    p(); NULL
  },future.seed=TRUE)
})

future::plan(future::sequential)

### CHECK FAILED JOBS
missing <- which(!file.exists(files))
if(length(missing)>0){
  print(jobs[missing,])
  stop("Some jobs failed. Rerun same code; completed jobs are retained.")
}


### GET SAVED CHECKPOINT FILES
ckpt <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Bayesian Spatial Modeling/OutPut/LOO_PI_checkpoints"

files <- list.files(ckpt,pattern="^job_[0-9]+\\.rds$",full.names=TRUE)
length(files)


### COMBINE RESULTS
loo <- bind_rows(lapply(files,readRDS)) %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  mutate(
    CrI_Covered95=Observed>=CrI_Lower95 & Observed<=CrI_Upper95,
    PI_Covered95=Observed>=PI_Lower95 & Observed<=PI_Upper95,
    Spearman=cor(Observed,Predicted,method="spearman")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Species,District,Observed,Predicted,CrI_Lower95,CrI_Upper95,
         PI_Lower95,PI_Upper95,CrI_Covered95,PI_Covered95,Spearman)

### SPEARMAN 95% CI
set.seed(12345)
sp_ci <- function(o,p,B=5000){
  b <- replicate(B,{i<-sample(seq_along(o),replace=TRUE); cor(o[i],p[i],method="spearman")})
  c(low=unname(quantile(b,.025,na.rm=TRUE)),high=unname(quantile(b,.975,na.rm=TRUE)))
}

### SUMMARY
loo_summary <- loo %>% group_by(Species) %>% group_modify(~{
  ci <- sp_ci(.x$Observed,.x$Predicted)
  tibble(
    N=nrow(.x),
    Spearman=cor(.x$Observed,.x$Predicted,method="spearman"),
    Spearman_CI_Low=ci["low"],Spearman_CI_High=ci["high"],
    CrI_Covered_N=sum(.x$CrI_Covered95),
    CrI_Coverage95=100*mean(.x$CrI_Covered95),
    PI_Covered_N=sum(.x$PI_Covered95),
    PI_Coverage95=100*mean(.x$PI_Covered95)
  )
}) %>% ungroup()

loo
loo_summary

### SAVE
write.csv(loo,file.path(outdir,"LOO_validation_ALL_results.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
```



##Plotting from LOO
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

setwd("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Bayesian Spatial Modeling/OutPut")

loo <- read.csv("LOO_validation_ALL_results.csv")

plot_dat <- loo %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  arrange(Predicted, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_scaled <- plot_dat %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  mutate(
    Pred_plot = ifelse(Species=="R. microplus", log(Predicted), Predicted),
    Obs_plot  = ifelse(Species=="R. microplus", log(Observed), Observed),
    Low_plot  = ifelse(Species=="R. microplus", log(CrI_Lower95), CrI_Lower95),
    High_plot = ifelse(Species=="R. microplus", log(CrI_Upper95), CrI_Upper95),
    sp_min = min(c(Obs_plot, Pred_plot, Low_plot, High_plot), na.rm=TRUE),
    sp_max = max(c(Obs_plot, Pred_plot, Low_plot, High_plot), na.rm=TRUE),
    Predicted_sc = (Pred_plot-sp_min)/(sp_max-sp_min),
    Observed_sc  = (Obs_plot-sp_min)/(sp_max-sp_min),
    CrI_Lower_sc = (Low_plot-sp_min)/(sp_max-sp_min),
    CrI_Upper_sc = (High_plot-sp_min)/(sp_max-sp_min)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

p2 <- ggplot(plot_scaled, aes(x=Order, y=Predicted_sc, group=1)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=CrI_Lower_sc, ymax=CrI_Upper_sc),
              fill="goldenrod", alpha=0.35) +
  geom_line(color="darkgoldenrod4", linewidth=1.15, lineend="round") +
  geom_point(aes(y=Observed_sc), color="firebrick", size=2.3, alpha=0.95) +
  facet_wrap(~Species, ncol=1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,1), breaks=seq(0,1,0.25)) +
  labs(
    x="Districts ordered by LOO predicted abundance",
    y="Scaled abundance"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size=14) +
  theme(
    panel.background=element_rect(fill="white", color=NA),
    plot.background=element_rect(fill="white", color=NA),
    strip.background=element_rect(fill="white", color="black", linewidth=0.8),
    strip.text=element_text(face="italic", size=14, color="black"),
    axis.text=element_text(color="black"),
    axis.title=element_text(color="black", face = "bold"),
    legend.position="none"
  )

p2

ggsave(
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Bayesian Spatial Modeling/OutPut/LOO_CrI_observed_vs_predicted_scaled_by_species.png",
  plot=p2,
  width=8,
  height=8,
  dpi=300,
  bg="white"
)

```
